what: On first open, the background-color curtain covering the screen starts lifting upward after .5s over 1s power4.out, and the stage-color curtain beneath it, .1s later, lifts on .8s expo.inOut and finishes first. It is an intro (1.5s) where the dark curtain briefly passes through the gap as the white one leaves. Skipped when arriving from within the same site.

options.delay: Wait before the first curtain lifts (sec), default .5
options.lag: Delay in seconds before the second act follows after the first act starts moving, default .1
options.ease · ease2: Curve of the two curtains — a GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”, default power4.out · expo.inOut
options.when: If external, open right away without the cover when arriving through a same-site link (cover only on reload or when coming from outside)

note: When fully cleared it becomes display: none and sends the fx:open event (bubbles). The original timeline sets the second curtain at ‹-=Set as 1.2” + delay .3 so it starts .1s after the first act begins — that resulting position is written as lag

from.where: All pages .ws-intro — white curtain #fff · ink curtain #232323
